image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months ended December 31, 2025, compared to the same period in 2024, along with a nine-month summary. Key metrics include revenues, operating profit, and net profit, with growth percentages indicating a 3.2% increase in revenues year-over-year and a 7.2% decrease in net profit. The operating margin decreased from 21.3% to 18.4%, while the diluted EPS fell from $0.19 to $0.18. The data highlights trends in financial performance, including a notable decline in operating profit and net profit, alongside varying growth rates in expenses.
